title: Kgolagano e e Kwadilweng Sešwa ke Tshenolo
intro: Akanya o neilwe motho yo o botlhokwa thata, morago ga moo o bo o lebane le taelo e e fedisang kgolagano eo ka ntlha ya go nna kutlo. Tshenolo e ne ya bopa lelapa lotlhe sesha, mme leina le le neng le le mo gare ga taelo ga le ise le ko le nne lone le le neng le buiwa ka lone.
clues: Ke ne ke eme fa boikanyegi jwa motho ka namana bo neng bo tshwanetse go ineela mo kutlong ya bomodimo.
Ke ne ke itsege mo ntlong ya Morongwa jaaka morwa yo o godisitsweng.
Ke ne ka ithuta gore lenyalo la me le ne la nna setlhogo sa tshenolo e e neng e lebisitswe kwa Morongwang wa ga Allah.
Ke ne ka utlwa mafoko a a reng, ‘Boloka mosadi wa gago mme o boife Allah,’ a lebisitswe mo go nna.
Ke ne ka ithuta morago ga moo gore Allah o ne a laela Morongwa wa ga Allah go tlhala basadi bangwe, mme lenyalo la me ka bonna le ne la tshwanelwa ke go fela ka fa tlase ga taelo eo.
Ke nna Zayd ibn Harithah, morwa yo o godisitsweng yo o bidiwang mo Sura Al-Ahzb.

identity.label: Ke Mang?
options: Zayd ibn Haritha
Moporofeti Harun
Moporofeti Yahya
Moengele wa Loso
Bomorwarraagwe Yusuf

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: Go bolelelwa gore a boloke mosadi wa gagwe mme morago a laelwe go mo tlhala
Go mediwa ke tlhapi e kgolo
Go latlhelwa mo leubelong le le tukang
Go robala mo teng ga logaga ka makgolokgolo a dingwaga
Go lebagana le noga ka thobane
trial.answer: Go bolelelwa gore a boloke mosadi wa gagwe mme morago a laelwe go mo tlhala

location.label: Elemente ya Botlhokwa
options: Ba ntlo ya Morongwa wa ga Allah
Ntlo ya segosi ya ga Faro kwa Egepeto
Logaga lwa balekane ba ba robetseng
Tshingwana ya balekane ba babedi ba ba dumelang
Ntlo ya segosi e e sireleditsweng ya ga Qarun
location.answer: Ba ntlo ya Morongwa wa ga Allah

outcome.label: Botso
options: O ne a ikobela taelo, a tlhala mosadi wa gagwe, mme lenyalo la phatlaladiwa .
O ne a namolwa mo leubelong le le tukang a sa gobala
O ne a namolwa morago ga go mediwa ke tlhapi e kgolo
Ke ne ka newa tshingwana e e nang le metswedi e mebedi
O ne a newa taolo ya Botlhaba le Bophirima
outcome.answer: O ne a ikobela taelo, a tlhala mosadi wa gagwe, mme lenyalo la phatlaladiwa .

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
